Name: Kenneth's Inspirational Mails
Author: Kf29
Description:
[size=4][b]Ever feel like your farmer needs a little morning pep talk?[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]I got you bro.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Kenneth's Inspirational Mails gives you one unique, heartfelt quote every single morning for a full year (112 days / 4 seasons). A chill little letter to start your day.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Perfect for those slow mornings when you're sipping coffee before watering your crops.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]What makes it different from Motivational?[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Inspirational = calm, reflective, for slow mornings.[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Motivational = energy, drive, for grinding and goal-setting.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]What you get:[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- 112 Unique Mails - No repeats, from Spring to Winter.[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Cozy Mindset - Quotes about growth, patience, sunshine, and small progress.[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Lore-friendly - Feels like a letter from a friend, not a random notification.[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Zero performance impact - Just pure Content Patcher mail, super lightweight.[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Compatible with everything - Works with any farm, any save, Expanded or Vanilla.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Example: "Keep your face always toward the sunshine and shadows will fall behind you. - Walt Whitman"[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]It's not about making the game easier or harder - it's about making your farm feel a little warmer.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Made with love by Kf - for farmers who believe small progress is still progress.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Install: Just drop in Mods folder. Requires SMAPI + Content Patcher.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Want more drive and hustle? Check out my other mod: Kenneth's Motivational Mails.[/b][/size]
